title: Non-Negotiables
description: Use for broad engineering tasks where the operator wants a compact baseline quality guard. Covers relevant docs, shared logic, source-of-truth preservation, sanctioned workflows, and stale generated artifact prevention.

requirements.statement: Code, CLI, config, workflow, or user-visible behavior changes must update relevant docs, role/skill guidance, examples, or help text when those artifacts discuss the changed behavior.

Use the intended source of truth and sanctioned workflow for the domain. Do not introduce parallel state, duplicate contracts, frontend-only truth, fake data, disabled checks, bypasses, manual workarounds, or stale generated/build artifacts unless the operator explicitly authorizes that scope change.

When behavior is used in more than one place, prefer a shared helper, component, schema, or established project abstraction over copying equivalent logic. Do not add abstraction for a single use unless it clearly matches an existing pattern or prevents near-term duplication.
